job_description_info.job_description:
# Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity

**Company:** Corvale Mobility (fictional name; intercity rail and coach operator)
**Location:** Kraków, Poland (contract, remote-friendly; occasional office days)
**Engagement:** Service agreement (B2B / freelance), not an employment contract
**Rate:** 95 – 125 PLN per hour

## The engagement

Corvale is preparing a new generation of trains and needs a cloud infrastructure engineer for the team that links the vehicles to the company's cloud platform. You will help shape the architecture from the start and take it to production.

## Scope

- Design, build and operate the cloud infrastructure that links on-board train systems with backend services: telemetry ingestion, alerting, video streaming and remote content updates
- Maintain the infrastructure-as-code repository (Terraform with Terragrunt), keeping it tidy and approachable
- Lead technical proposals across backend and infrastructure from idea to production
- Contribute to system design and challenge decisions with arguments
- Set up secure train-to-cloud communication (mutual TLS, certificate management, network design)
- Agree interfaces and responsibilities with train manufacturers' engineers
- Support backend developers in deploying services that are easy to monitor and run
- Keep the platform observable, reliable and secure

## Requirements

- Hands-on infrastructure engineering and cloud environment design and operation
- AWS preferred; other major clouds acceptable
- Strong Terraform and Terragrunt
- Good understanding of systems architecture and system design
- Networking knowledge, including mTLS and SSL/TLS
- Practical security awareness
- Experience leading technical topics and bringing stakeholders along
- Strong analytical thinking and clear communication

**Nice to have:** IoT or automotive/remote-device integration, backend or full-stack background (JVM preferred), Linux and virtual machines.

## Working model

Independent contractor, invoicing monthly for agreed services.

company_info.company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It provides long-distance bus and passenger-rail travel across Central Europe, supported by online booking, trip tracking and travel extras. Its asset-light model combines regional operating partners with Corvale’s own booking platform, network planning and brand. The company is expanding its rail service and investing in data and machine learning.

Founded by transport and software professionals, Corvale describes itself as engineering-led: teams take end-to-end ownership of their systems, and technology is central to improving how people travel. Its stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey**. The company also highlights sustainability, shared goals, career ownership and collaborative problem-solving.

Corvale’s culture is described as fast-moving, open to new ideas and collaborative, with international teams and a focus on professional development, employee appreciation and work-life flexibility. It says it acts on employee feedback; technology roles may offer hybrid work and, in some cases, contractor arrangements.

NADIA BRENNAN-AZIZ
Senior Cloud Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
Manchester, UK | nadia.brennanaziz@example.com | +44 7700 900909 | github.com/nba-sre-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior cloud infrastructure and platform engineer with 10 years of experience in infrastructure, including six years running Kubernetes platforms on AWS. Hands-on experience designing, building and operating cloud environments, with strong Terraform experience and a track record of leading technical work from proposal through production. Builds self-service infrastructure and observable, reliable platforms that help product teams deploy and operate services effectively.

CORE SKILLS
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, SQS, Route 53, CloudFront), Terraform, Atlantis, Kubernetes, Linux
Platform engineering: Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, Crossplane, Karpenter, GitHub Actions
Observability and reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, SLOs and error budgets, incident management
Programming and automation: Go, Python, Bash, Puppet
Testing and operations: k6, on-call operations, capacity planning

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Platform Engineer | Tallybrook Ltd (B2B accounting SaaS)
Manchester / remote | Apr 2022 – present
- Technical lead for a five-person platform team, operating an AWS EKS platform spanning eight clusters, approximately 350 services and three regions.
- Built an internal developer platform with service templates, Argo CD GitOps and Crossplane-based self-service provisioning for RDS, SQS and S3; reduced the time for a new service to reach production from approximately two weeks to under one day.
- Introduced SLOs and error budgets for the 20 most critical services, reducing on-call pages per week by approximately 60%.
- Moved node provisioning to Karpenter with spot instances, reducing EC2 spend by 38%.
- Serve in the incident commander rotation and established the incident and post-mortem process.

Site Reliability Engineer | Brightwater Games
Leeds | Jan 2019 – Mar 2022
- Operated AWS game backend infrastructure (EC2, ECS and later EKS) for titles with up to 1.2 million daily active players.
- Managed AWS infrastructure as code with approximately 40 Terraform modules, using Atlantis for plan and apply workflows on pull requests.
- Replaced a noisy Nagios setup with a Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager and Loki observability stack.
- Ran k6 load tests and launch-day capacity planning ahead of game launches.

Linux Systems Engineer | Pennine Hosting
Sheffield | Jul 2016 – Dec 2018
- Managed approximately 600 Linux servers for hosting customers using Puppet configuration management.
- Automated operational tasks with Bash and Python and provided on-call support for customer incidents.

EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science | University of the North Moors | 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) | 2021; renewed 2024
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional | 2023

LANGUAGES
English (native) | Urdu (conversational)

cover_letter_history.content:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role. I bring 10 years of infrastructure experience, including six years operating Kubernetes platforms on AWS, and a strong record of designing and building infrastructure that helps product teams deploy and run services reliably. Corvale’s engineering-led approach and the opportunity to help shape a new train-to-cloud platform from its early architecture through to production particularly appeal to me.

In my current role as Senior Platform Engineer at Tallybrook, I am technical lead for a five-person team operating an AWS EKS platform across eight clusters, around 350 services and three regions. I built an internal developer platform using service templates, Argo CD GitOps and Crossplane-based self-service provisioning for RDS, SQS and S3, reducing the time for a new service to reach production from around two weeks to under one day. This work has involved turning platform needs into practical infrastructure and supporting developers with services that are easier to deploy and operate.

I also bring hands-on infrastructure-as-code and reliability experience relevant to Corvale’s scope. At Brightwater Games, I managed AWS infrastructure through approximately 40 Terraform modules, with Atlantis workflows for plan and apply on pull requests, and supported backend systems serving titles with up to 1.2 million daily active players. Across my roles, I have improved observability, introduced SLOs and error budgets, planned capacity, and contributed to incident response. As incident commander in rotation and technical lead, I am accustomed to taking ownership of technical work and helping teams deliver operationally sound systems.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my AWS platform, Terraform and operational experience could contribute to Corvale’s fleet connectivity work and its end-to-end ownership of technology. Thank you for your consideration.

Yours sincerely,
Nadia Brennan-Aziz
